17.text: This report is very interesting. The name “Chiukhcha” is mentioned in

18.text: it for the first time; and from the words of Stadukhin it follows that in that

19.text: time, on the Chukchee River, to the west of the Kolyma, there lived natives

20.text: called Chukchee, Reindeer and sedentary. I mentioned before that those na-

21.text: tives were probably of Čaˊačên stock.³ Still more remarkable are the details

22.text: concerning the walrus-hunt of those natives on one of the Bear Islands.

23.text: Walrus, even in modern times, migrate to the northern shores of the Bear

24.text: Islands; and the Reindeer Chukchee sometimes go over to those islands for

25.text: the purpose of hunting them, just as described in the report. In the time of

26.text: Stadukhin, however, walrus-hunting was evidently carried on more extensively.
